rows.note: Use this for the colloquial, emphatic slice where someone insists that a claim is certainly true.

example.english: They assert that they didn't take that book.
example.traditional: 佢一口咬定自己冇拎嗰本書。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hau2 ngaau5 ding6 zi6 gei2 mou5 ling1 go2 bun2 syu1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for neutrally reporting that someone states a claim or position.

example.english: They assert at the press conference that they did not do it.
example.traditional: 佢喺記者會上聲稱自己冇做過呢件事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gei3 ze2 wui2 soeng6 sing1 cing1 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 gwo3 ni1 gin6 si6

rows.note: Use this when asserting a right or authority by exercising it, as in 行使權利 or 行使權力.

example.english: They assert their authority by exercising veto power.
example.traditional: 佢行使否決權，表明自己有決定權。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hang4 si2 fau2 kyut3 kyun4 biu2 ming4 zi6 gei2 jau5 kyut3 ding6 kyun4

rows.note: Use this when someone stands firm and refuses to let their position or rights be dismissed.

example.english: We assert ourselves and will not accept this unfair arrangement.
example.traditional: 我哋企硬，唔會接受呢個唔公平嘅安排。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kei5 ngaang6 m4 wui5 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3 on1 paai4
